title: Inter's greatest season ever: 1964–65, 2009–10 or 2023–24? #Shorts
description:
Inter's greatest season of all time? Our pick: 1964–65, Helenio Herrera's Grande Inter.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?v=debate6 — the Italian Inter press in English every morning, free

THE DEBATE — a weekly fan-made argument, not the news.

1964–65 (Helenio Herrera): Scudetto with 54 points, 22 wins and only 2 defeats in 34 games; European Cup, 1–0 v Benfica at San Siro on May 27, 1965 (Jair); Intercontinental Cup v Independiente, won 1–0 after extra time in the Madrid play-off (Corso). Champions of Italy, Europe and the world in the same season. Coppa Italia runners-up.
2009–10 (José Mourinho): Serie A with 82 points (24 wins, 10 draws, 4 defeats), 2 points ahead of Roma; Coppa Italia, 1–0 v Roma on May 5, 2010 (Milito); Champions League, 2–0 v Bayern Munich in Madrid on May 22, 2010 (Milito ×2). The only treble by an Italian club.
2023–24 (Simone Inzaghi): Serie A with 94 points (29 wins, 7 draws, 2 defeats), 89 scored and 22 conceded, clinched 2–1 in the derby on April 22, 2024 — the 20th title and the second star; Supercoppa Italiana, 1–0 v Napoli on January 22, 2024 (Lautaro Martínez). Out of the Coppa Italia and the Champions League in the round of 16.

Sources: inter.it (club history and honours), uefa.com, Wikipedia (English).
Fan-made — not affiliated with FC Internazionale Milano.
